## Clustering

After transforming the fcs files stained with both panels and verifying all parameters look okay, we can proceed to the clustering
Choose the parameters to cluster on for each panel
Load the transformed, unmixed and with updated metadata gatingsets obtained from the 01_QC_cleanup script

```{r}

path_PB_gs<- file.path(paths$afterqc, "/Panel B")

PB_GatingSet_t<- load_gs(path_PB_gs)
```

```{r}
#plot the heatmap that is included in the flowsommary report, I modified the automatic function in order to be able to plot both the scaled and non-scaled values

PlotMFIHeatmap_mc <- function(fsom, scale = c("zscore", "none", "minmax"),
                              heatmapColors = c("#313695", "#4575B4", "#74ADD1", "#ABD9E9", "#E0F3F8",
                                                "#FEE090", "#FDAE61", "#F46D43", "#D73027", "#A50026"),
                              cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, labels = TRUE) {
  scale <- match.arg(scale)
  fsom  <- FlowSOM::UpdateFlowSOM(fsom)

  mfi <- FlowSOM::GetMetaclusterMFIs(fsom, colsUsed = TRUE, prettyColnames = TRUE)  

  mat <- t(switch(scale,
    zscore = base::scale(mfi),                                              
    none   = mfi,                                                           
    minmax = apply(mfi, 2, function(x) (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))))  
  raw <- t(mfi)                                                            

  cols_mc <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(ncol(mat)), colnames(mat))          # ggplot default colours
  mc_df   <- data.frame(metaclustering = factor(colnames(mat), levels = colnames(mat)))
  mc_a <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(df = mc_df, col = list(metaclustering = cols_mc),
                                            border = TRUE, show_legend = FALSE)

  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(mat, col = heatmapColors,
    cluster_rows = cluster_rows, cluster_columns = cluster_columns,
    show_column_names = TRUE, column_names_side = "top",
    bottom_annotation = mc_a, border = TRUE,
    name = switch(scale, zscore = "z-score", none = "MFI", minmax = "0-1"),
    cell_fun = if (labels) function(j, i, x, y, w, h, col)
      grid::grid.text(round(raw[i, j], 2), x, y) else NULL)
}
```

``` {r}
#function to plot the clusters and metaclusters in a 2D scatter plot of the different marker combinations

plot_metaclusters <- function(fsom, channelpair, density = FALSE,
                              seed = 42, ncells = 3000) {

  mcs <- sort(unique(as.character(GetMetaclusters(fsom))))   
  mcs_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mcs))
  if (!anyNA(mcs_num)) mcs <- as.character(sort(mcs_num))  

  plots <- lapply(mcs, function(mc) {
    set.seed(seed)                                  
    p <- Plot2DScatters(fsom,
                        channelpairs = list(channelpair),
                        metaclusters = list(if (!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mc)))) as.numeric(mc) else mc),
                        plotFile = NULL,
                        maxBgPoints= ncells)
    p[[1]] + ggtitle(paste("Metacluster", mc))
  })
  names(plots) <- mcs
  plots
}
```

```{r}
#for the UMAP, we want to extract the metadata of each cell that is stored in the flowsom object
#the cell_file function extracts the information on which cells belong to each sample, for example 
#sample 1 goes from cell 1 to cell 67792, so the function extracts these indices and calculates the number of cells in each file
#the result is an object where each row is a cell and the name of the sample is repeated the amount of times as cells has that file

cell_file <- function(fsom) {
  md <- fsom$metaData
  md <- md[order(sapply(md, `[`, 1))]                 
  lens <- sapply(md, function(r) r[2] - r[1] + 1)
  rep(names(md), times = lens)
}

#function to perform UMAP on the data stored in the FlowSOM object

umap_df <- function(fsom, mclusters, meta_table, channels = NULL,
                    n_per_sample = NULL, seed = 42,
                    n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.3) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  mk <- intersect(colnames(fsom$data), channels)
  file <- cell_file(fsom)
  clusters <- FlowSOM::GetClusters(fsom)              
  stopifnot(length(file) == nrow(fsom$data), length(mclusters) == nrow(fsom$data),
            length(clusters) == nrow(fsom$data))

  # cells to use: all of them, or the same number per sample
  if (is.null(n_per_sample)) {
    idx <- seq_len(nrow(fsom$data))
  } else {
    idx <- sort(unlist(lapply(split(seq_along(file), file),
                              function(i) sample(i, min(n_per_sample, length(i))))))
  }

  um <- uwot::umap(fsom$data[idx, mk, drop = FALSE],
                   n_neighbors = n_neighbors, min_dist = min_dist,
                   n_threads = 1, seed = seed)

  out <- tibble(UMAP1 = um[, 1], UMAP2 = um[, 2],
         metacluster = factor(mclusters[idx]),
         cluster     = factor(clusters[idx]),
         file        = file[idx]) %>%
    left_join(meta_table, by = c("file" = "file_name")) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble(fsom$data[idx, mk, drop = FALSE]))

  if (nrow(out) != length(idx)) warning("Join changed the number of rows: duplicated file names in meta_table?")
  if (anyNA(out[[setdiff(names(meta_table), "file_name")[1]]]))
    warning("Some cells have no metadata: file names don't match.")
  out
}

plot_umap_nodes <- function(df, color_by = "metacluster", node_col = "cluster",
                            palette = NULL, nodes = NULL, min_cells = 0,
                            label_size = 2.5, title = NULL) {

  df[[color_by]] <- factor(df[[color_by]])
  if (is.null(palette)) palette <- unname(pals::glasbey(nlevels(df[[color_by]])))
  df_plot <- df[sample(nrow(df)), ]

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[color_by]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = palette) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1), ncol = 2)) +
    labs(title = title, colour = color_by) + theme_bw()

  if (!is.null(node_col)) {
    centers <- df %>% group_by(.data[[node_col]]) %>%
      summarise(UMAP1 = median(UMAP1), UMAP2 = median(UMAP2), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
    if (!is.null(nodes)) centers <- centers %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[node_col]] %in% nodes)
    centers <- centers %>% dplyr::filter(n >= min_cells)
    p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = centers,
                                      aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = .data[[node_col]]),
                                      colour = "black", size = label_size,
                                      max.overlaps = Inf, segment.size = 0.2,
                                      inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }
  p
}

plot_umap_marker <- function(df, marker,
                             split_by = NULL,      
                             ncol = NULL,         
                             size = 0.2,
                             clip = c(0.01, 0.99),
                             title = NULL,        
                             cluster_col = NULL,   
                             label_size = 3,
                             label_fun = median,   
                             save_path = NULL,    
                             panel_width = 4, panel_height = 4, dpi = 300) {

  stopifnot(length(marker) == 1, marker %in% names(df))
  stopifnot(length(split_by) <= 2)

  for (v in split_by) {
    df <- df[!is.na(df[[v]]), ]
    df[[v]] <- droplevels(as.factor(df[[v]]))
  }

    centroids <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cluster_col)) {
    centroids <- df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[cluster_col]])) %>%
      group_by(cluster_label = .data[[cluster_col]]) %>%
      summarise(UMAP1 = label_fun(UMAP1),
                UMAP2 = label_fun(UMAP2),
                .groups = "drop")
  }

  q <- quantile(df[[marker]], clip, na.rm = TRUE)
  df$value <- pmin(pmax(df[[marker]], q[1]), q[2])

  df <- df %>% arrange(value)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = value)) +
    geom_point(size = size) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
    labs(colour = "Expression", title = title %||% marker) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

  n_panels <- 1
  n_col <- 1
  n_row <- 1

  if (length(split_by) == 1) {
    n_panels <- nlevels(df[[split_by]])
    if (is.null(ncol)) ncol <- ceiling(sqrt(n_panels))
    p <- p + facet_wrap(split_by, ncol = ncol)
    n_col <- min(ncol, n_panels)
    n_row <- ceiling(n_panels / ncol)
  } else if (length(split_by) == 2) {
    
    p <- p + facet_grid(rows = split_by[1], cols = split_by[2])
    n_row <- nlevels(df[[split_by[1]]])
    n_col <- nlevels(df[[split_by[2]]])
  }

if (!is.null(centroids)) {
  p <- p + geom_shadowtext(
    data = centroids,
    aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = cluster_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = label_size,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "black",
    bg.colour = "white",
    bg.r = 0.15          # halo thickness
  )
}
 
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p,
           width  = panel_width  * n_col + 1.5, 
           height = panel_height * n_row,
           dpi = dpi, limitsize = FALSE)
  }

  p
}

plot_umap_marker(umap_PA, "S100A8", split_by = "antiCSP_M3",
                  cluster_col = "metacluster_label", label_fun= mean)

plot_umap_marker(umap_PB, "CD14", split_by = "antiCSP_M3",
                  cluster_col = "metacluster_label", label_fun= mean)

plot_umap_markers(df_PB_sub, channels_PB, label_map = label_map_PB)

plot_umap_highlight <- function(df, var, group, colour = "#D55E00", title = NULL,
                                color_by = NULL, palette = NULL) {
  df <- df[sample(nrow(df)), ]
  in_grp  <- df[[var]] == group
  bg      <- df[!in_grp, ]
  fg      <- df[in_grp, ]

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = bg, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2), colour = "grey85", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.5)

  if (is.null(color_by)) {
    # all highlighted cells in one colour
    p <- p + geom_point(data = fg, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2), colour = colour, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6)
  } else {
    # highlighted cells coloured by another variable, e.g. metacluster
    fg[[color_by]] <- factor(fg[[color_by]])
    if (is.null(palette)) palette <- unname(pals::glasbey(nlevels(fg[[color_by]])))
    p <- p + geom_point(data = fg, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[color_by]]),
                        size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = palette) +
      guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1), ncol = 2))
  }

  p + labs(title = title %||% paste(var, "=", group)) + theme_bw()
}

plot_umap_highlight(df_PA_sub, "antiCSP_M3", "Control")    
plot_umap_highlight(df_PA_sub, "antiCSP_M3", "High") 
plot_umap_highlight(df_PA_sub, "antiCSP_M3", "Low") 

#split umap by high and low responders

umap_PA_high<- umap_PA_sub %>% 
  dplyr::filter(antiCSP_M3=="High")

umap_PA_low<- umap_PA_sub %>% 
  dplyr::filter(antiCSP_M3=="Low")

plot_umap_markers(umap_PA_high, channels_PA, label_map = label_map_PA)

plot_umap_markers(umap_PA_low, channels_PA, label_map = label_map_PA)
```
